propositions: Mirror Guard workflow runs fail on single instantaneous replication lag samples during normal post-submit convergence, generating false-positive reds on expected self-healing Gerrit->GitHub divergence.

The module's design docstring (d96628c9dca) delegates transient-lag absorption to the alarm layer's sustained-divergence window, but the workflow primary watcher has no evaluation window while the CloudWatch secondary does (monitoring_ws7.tf 2x5-min).

The incomplete-implementation caused by a774-5ca9-3a80-4f6d shipped replication_verdict (instantaneous truth) and the workflow (single-sample mapping) without the designed lag-tolerance window on the CLI/workflow surface.

Fix adds portable in-process evaluation window replication_check_with_lag_tolerance (3 samples, 45s apart, ~90s total window, ~6x documented ~15s lag) to run() and main(), failing only on persistent divergence, not transient convergence.
Convergent transient lag now exits 0 immediately upon convergence; static GitHub-ahead or stalled replication still exits 1 every run; missing SHA fails immediately without re-sampling.
